lyrics:
[Intro: warm pad, soft kick, a car door, wind]

[Verse 1: clear cool female voice]
Bridge behind me, bags in back
Radio's found a station I like
Palm, palm, pink motel
Ocean flashing on my left side

[Chorus: full melodic house groove, voice doubled]
A1A, windows down
Every mile a little lighter
A1A, salt and sound
I can feel the week untie
A1A

[Drop: rising synth melody, bass, claps]

[Verse 2: voice warmer]
Drawbridge up, I don't mind
Pelican on a piling, still
Somebody's waiting with a cold one
I'll be there when I get there

[Chorus: full groove, voice doubled]
A1A, windows down
Every mile a little lighter
A1A, salt and sound
I can feel the week untie
A1A

[Outro: pad, tires on a shell driveway, engine off]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 122 BPM, 4/4, B-flat major. Warm, steady and gently euphoric, a drive at dusk.

VOICE: Female, clear, cool and unforced, mid-range, with soft reverb. Doubled in the choruses. She sings the road's name as three letters and numbers: A, one, A.

INSTRUMENTS: Warm analogue pads, a soft four-on-the-floor kick, a rounded bass, a patient rising synth melody, claps and shakers, a plucked guitar-like synth, wind and car sounds.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, pad and car door. 0:20 Verse 1. 0:48 Chorus 1. 1:16 Drop. 1:44 Verse 2. 2:12 Chorus 2. 2:42 Outro, a driveway and engine off, ends 3:28.

PRODUCTION & MIX: 2020 melodic house: warm, wide and smooth, pads glowing, kick soft, voice clear.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: 'I can feel the week untie' at 1:04.

STATION FIT: Saturday, 5 p.m. The set's opening track: the drive down the coast before anything has happened.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Leaving, loosening, patient, arrived.
